desc: Derive and prove an exact feasibility algorithm for a target distance \(D\) using threshold variables and minimum cut.
Prove the optimization method, including the validity of using “at most \(K\)” when exactly \(K\) edges must be selected.
Develop implementation details and complexity analysis under the given constraints.
Check edge cases including parallel edges, \(K=M\), direct edges, cycles, and zero-distance answers.
Validate the algorithm against all three samples and verify the layered min-cut formulation.
